is not derivable from anything: `kox` is Knight of Xoroth and `rm` is
Runemaster, but nothing in the class name, the class id or the WeakAuras
load token would tell you either. There is no published glossary -- the only
corroboration found for `kox` was Ascension's own social post ('Play with
your KoX on Conquest of Azeroth'), so this file is where the rest of it gets
written down as it turns up.
